correctness.rationale: For each a,c≥1, the tree B_{a,c} has spine u-v-w-z and endpoint leaf sets A,C. Ind₂ forbids selected three-vertex paths. Ind₂ of a k-leaf star is a union of the leaf simplex and cone over its zero skeleton, hence ≃vee^{k−1}S¹. Deleting v leaves disjoint stars S_a and S_{c+1}; their independence-complex join D≃vee^{(a−1)c}S³, including contractible boundary a=1. The link of v equals (Δ_A*Q)∪(u*Ind₂(S_c)), glued along Ind₂(S_c), yielding ΣInd₂(S_c)≃vee^{c−1}S². The map link→D is null because D is 2-connected (or contractible), and deletion/link cofiber splits into D∨Σlink ≃vee^{ac−1}S³; a=c=1 is contractible. Independently enumerated induced-P3-free faces for every 1≤a,c≤4 and exact F₂ boundary homology for K, D and link, confirming these three predicted multiplicities. The all-integer all-parameter proof is the join/link argument, not finite mod-2 homology.
